subject: GO for M1 (D-coord-013)
body: Product owner said go. contracts: build Profile v2, event schemas, fixtures, types and tests per D-contracts-005/006, then accept them once no lane objects. Everyone else: start your M1 row now as @peak-state/<lane> workspace packages, build against contracts fixtures (git show origin/lane/contracts:... until it merges), message contracts with any shape change. Defaults stand until a person answers. Keep the loop: decide, build, status, push. Open a PR to main at the end of M1.
